description: Hey, I'm Adam!  I am not a professional electrician, plumber, or HVAC tech, I am a fellow DIYer who loves to install, and make repairs on my own home and properties.  I share information I have learned (and continue to learn) along the way, and create content focused on DIY, how tos, tips and tricks, and reviews of products used around the home.  I offer information and ways to save money on projects, builds, renovations, and everyday repairs.  I will touch on projects covering woodworking, renovations, electrical, air conditioning, lawn and garden, power equipment, and solutions to typical problems around the house, just to name a few.  New content will be uploaded regularly.  Please click that subscribe button to get updates on all of the new time and money saving life hacks I have coming your way!
